description: Create a signer in the workspace. Search with assinafy_list_signers first to avoid duplicates. Sends no invitation.

account_id.description: Authorized workspace; discovered from OAuth when omitted.

government_id.description: Signer's CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 characters; may be alphanumeric). Formatting is accepted and the value is normalized on save. Required before the signer can use a verification method that identifies them by CPF.

name: assinafy_create_signer
title: Create signer
